cohort: This study included 289 premature infants born between 22 and 37 weeks gestation at General Hospital Pula from 2012 to 2016.
finding: This study described the epidemiological characteristics of premature infants born at a single center over a 5-year period, finding that most infants were late preterm, male, and appropriate for gestational age.
mod_finding: Of the 289 premature infants, 167 (58%) were delivered vaginally and 122 (42%) were delivered by cesarean section.
